Blocks.Text: To ensure both Apply with LinkedIn Plugin integration and Middleware Platform integration work as expected, LinkedIn must certify the finished development.

Middleware Platform integration applies only to LinkedIn partners implementing Apply with LinkedIn for multiple customers (for example, an ATS).
Review the appropriate documentation and send technical questions to your business development contact or partner engineering representative.

Upon completing development, please review the test cases below and record a short video demonstrating each test case. LinkedIn will certify based on the complete coverage of test cases in the submitted certification video.

One video should capture all test cases. We do not accept multiple video files. Refer to the sample certification video.

Upon successful certification, LinkedIn provides you with a new Parent API Key for Production.

The video should not exceed 10 minutes
The video file format should be a common video format (mp4, AVI, MOV)
The file name must follow the following format: Partner Name_ AWLI_CERT_ MM_DD_YY.mp4
The file should not exceed 100MB

The sample certification video provided here covers all of the test scenarios described below.
Review this video to ensure your certification video follows a similar structure and reduce the chance of resubmitting because a test case is missing.

Blocks.Section: Module 1 - Customer configuration (for partners, such as ATS providers)
SectionPath: Module 1 - Customer configuration (for partners, such as ATS providers)
Blocks.Text: The following test cases are for LinkedIn partners implementing Apply with LinkedIn for multiple customers. For instance, if you are an Applicant Tracking System (ATS) service provider, you should demonstrate the following test cases. See Middleware Platform.

Blocks.Section: Module 1 - Customer configuration (for partners, such as ATS providers)
SectionPath: Module 1 - Customer configuration (for partners, such as ATS providers)

Rows.Text: AWLI-001
Demo a functioning customer configuration plugin on your settings/integration page
The configuration widget loads, allowing the admin user to enable the integration
AWLI-002
Demo receiving a working integrationContext for a customer who turns on Apply with LinkedIn in the customer configuration plugin
The integrationContext is received and presented using the developer console in your browser, logs, or any other visual aid
AWLI-003
Demo customers can update or add validJsSdkDomains for their application

The AWLI widget and plugin button are available only on the listed domains for the customer application. Customers can configure multiple domains or edit existing domains based on their requirements. For wildcard domain support, contact LinkedIn through the partner support form.

Blocks.Section: Module 2 - Deploy the Apply with LinkedIn widget (for partners, such as ATS providers)
SectionPath: Module 2 - Deploy the Apply with LinkedIn widget (for partners, such as ATS providers)
Blocks.Text: The following test cases are for LinkedIn partners implementing Apply with LinkedIn for multiple customers. See Apply with LinkedIn Plugin.

Blocks.Section: Module 2 - Deploy the Apply with LinkedIn widget (for partners, such as ATS providers)
SectionPath: Module 2 - Deploy the Apply with LinkedIn widget (for partners, such as ATS providers)

Rows.Text: AWLI-004
Demo the application flow

The Apply With LinkedIn button renders on a customer's job posted on their career site. Once authenticated using LinkedIn credentials, the OAuth consent screen displays. Once consent is given, the application form populates correctly.
AWLI-005
Demo the Apply with LinkedIn widget in conversion mode on the completion page.

The plugin triggers the conversion tracking event from the job submission page and sends it to LinkedIn systems when the data-mode plugin parameter is set to CONVERSION. In-browser developer tools log the event accurately in the console and display the track conversion call on the submit page. If the job is non-paid, http-status 400 error appears, which is a valid response.
